fact_definition: Reported assertion or derived calculation with source trace; estimates and opinions are separately labeled.

facts: Q2 sales $8.531B, +21% YoY; organic growth 14%.
Electrical Americas sales $3.951B, organic growth 18%, operating margin 27.5%, rolling orders +41%, backlog +33% YoY.
Electrical Global sales $2.517B, organic growth 18%, rolling orders +33%, backlog +103% YoY.
Aerospace sales $1.222B, organic growth 7%, backlog +28% YoY.
Q2 OCF $1.127B and company-defined FCF $0.874B.
FY2026 organic-growth guidance 11-13%; adjusted EPS $13.40-$13.60.
H1 sales $15.982B vs $13.404B; attributable net income $1.687B vs $1.945B.
H1 OCF $1.634B vs $1.156B; PPE capex $0.446B vs $0.349B.
Firm-commitment backlog $24.1B at June 30; approximately 71% targeted for delivery within 12 months. Open orders subject to customer releases are excluded from backlog unless firm.
Cash $0.483B, short-term investments $0.212B, short-term debt $2.091B, current LT debt $0.011B and LT debt $18.509B.
388.4M ordinary shares outstanding vs 389.3M at June 30, 2025.
Boyd Thermal acquired for $9.549B; adjusted preliminary goodwill $3.733B and other intangibles $7.190B.
Ultra PCS acquired for $1.529B; goodwill $0.849B and other intangibles $0.791B.
H1 acquisition cash spending $11.079B; borrowing proceeds $9.871B; no 2026 repurchases through June.
FY2025 sales $27.448B, attributable net income $4.087B, OCF $4.472B and PPE capex $0.919B.
No single customer represented more than 10% of company net sales; six large Electrical customers represented 22% of Electrical segment sales.
EY issued unqualified opinions on the 2025 financial statements and ICFR.
Eaton's principal Electrical competition is based on product/system performance, technology, service/support and price; management describes the company as a market leader in many products.
Eaton Mobility is planned to combine with Dana in a Reverse Morris Trust expected to close Q1 2027.
Eaton expects an approximately $1.1B cash distribution and Eaton shareholders are expected to own at least 50.1% of the combined company.
Eaton states the separation should increase the remaining portfolio's organic-growth rate and margins upon closing.
Management target: 6-9% organic revenue CAGR through 2030.
Management target: 28% segment operating margin.
Management target: 95-100% FCF conversion of adjusted earnings and adjusted EPS CAGR above 12%.
EIA projected U.S. electricity demand to reach records in 2026 and 2027, with AI/data centers contributing to commercial-load growth.
AI infrastructure financing conditions were becoming more selective amid construction delays and large debt issuance; used only as an end-market risk signal, not an Eaton-specific fact.

source_quality_note: Primary company filings and official IR dominate quantitative claims. Secondary price and macro sources are labeled. No provider market-cap figure is used; market cap is calculated from filing shares and the reference close.
